description: What a beat can do (beats[].do[].do). at is seconds from the beat's start (default 0). target names an object id; "camera" moves the camera.

show.description: Make a hidden object appear (scales up from nothing).

hide.description: Shrink an object away and hide it.

pop.description: Pop an object in with an overshoot and a sound (numbers, letters).

params.to: [x, y, z] landing spot (the object's base)

drop.description: Drop an object from above; it bounces and squashes as it lands.

params.target: object id, or <id>#<part> for a named part (offset from its rest pose)
object id, or <id>#<part> for a named part (offset from its rest pose)
object id, or <id>#<part> for a named part (offset from its rest pose)

spin.description: Spin around the vertical axis and stop where it began.

hop.description: A quick hop up and back down; it adds to position, so a hopping object can also move.

params.to: scale factor (number, default 1.3), or [x, y, z] factors to stretch one way (a water level rising: [1, 2, 1])

grow.description: Scale to a new size and stay.

params.loop: default true for Idle/Dance/Walking/Running, else false
params.then: clip to return to afterwards, default the idle

camera.description: Move the camera (any of position, lookAt, fov).

params.voice: a timbre from catalog/story/tts_voices.json or "narrator", default meta.voice
params.caption: true to also show the words as a caption

say.description: Speak a line with Piper TTS; the beat lasts at least as long as the voice.

params.dur: default the rest of the beat
params.style: title (centre), label (a naming word above the subtitles), count (big numeral, right third), subtitle (bottom, wraps), default subtitle
params.color: colors.json name for the text (colour lessons), default the style's

burst.description: Fire a confetti or bubbles object (bubbles rise for dur seconds, default 8).

params.target: object id, or <id>#<part> for a named part (offset from its rest pose)

wiggle.description: A happy side-to-side wiggle that settles back.

params.target: critter id (its head nods) or any object

sleep.description: Close the eyes slowly and stay asleep.

params.target: critter, character or shape with face: true
params.feeling: happy, sad, surprised, angry, worried or sleepy

feel.description: Show a feeling: eyebrows, mouth and eyes change and the head tilts (Robo uses his face). Stays until the next feel.

params.from: colors.json name: blend only the parts drawn in this colour (after recolor) instead of the main colour; critters and props

paint.description: Blend the object's main colour to another colour (a leaf turning orange, a describing word changing a balloon). With from, blend the parts drawn in that colour instead (a plant's leaf parts turning brown).

params.rig: lights name (soft_day, studio, moonlight, evening, dim, overcast...)

lights.description: Change the stage's light and colours over time: day to night, a dim theatre, a grey winter sky, sand to snow.

params.to: time like "3:30"; the hands always go forward
params.minuteHand: false hides the long hand, true shows it

clock.description: Turn a clock's hands to a time, the way a real clock moves.

params.to: [x, y, z] the spot to light

aim.description: Point a lamp at a new spot (a torch sweeping across a wall).

params.points: list of [x, y, z] to travel through
params.face: true turns it toward where it is going

path.description: Travel through points at an even speed (a train along its track, a route on a map, a rocket's arc).
